Evidence, with limits. This detector can misclassify real and generated images, especially new generators, edits, and compressed files. The score is a model output, not a calibrated probability. Missing provenance is not evidence of authenticity.

About the detector

Uses AI Image Detect Distilled, trained on camera images and Midjourney / Stable Diffusion images, via its ONNX conversion. The author reports 74% validation accuracy; this app has not independently validated it. Results below 20% or above 80% receive directional labels; these are interface thresholds, not validated operating points. This version does not verify Content Credentials or identify a specific generator.

Internet is needed to load the library and model. Images are never sent to an analysis server. No account, API key, or paid detection service is required.
